name: 児童相談所の名称と担当区域を変更
summary: 現在、杉並区は都の児童相談所の担当区域に含まれ、小金井市と国分寺市は東京都小平児童相談所の担当です。2026年11月1日に杉並区を都の担当区域から外し、東京都杉並児童相談所を東京都多摩中部児童相談所として設置します。2027年4月1日には、小金井市と国分寺市の担当も東京都多摩中部児童相談所に変わります。
changes: 杉並区を都の児童相談所の担当区域から外す
東京都杉並児童相談所を東京都多摩中部児童相談所として設置する
東京都多摩中部児童相談所が武蔵野市と三鷹市を担当する
小金井市と国分寺市の担当を東京都小平児童相談所から東京都多摩中部児童相談所に変える
who: 杉並区で児童相談所を利用する人
武蔵野市・三鷹市で児童相談所を利用する人
小金井市・国分寺市で児童相談所を利用する人
why: 児童福祉法施行令の改正に伴う杉並区の事務に関する規定の整理と、東京都多摩中部児童相談所の設置に必要な改正を行うためと、都は説明しています。

en.name: Changes a child guidance center's name and service areas
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Child Guidance Center Ordinance
en.summary: Currently, Suginami City is included in the area served by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government's child guidance centers, while Koganei City and Kokubunji City are served by the Tokyo Kodaira Child Guidance Center. On November 1, 2026, Suginami City will be removed from the areas served by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government's child guidance centers, and the Tokyo Suginami Child Guidance Center will be established under the name Tokyo Tama-Chubu Child Guidance Center. On April 1, 2027, responsibility for Koganei City and Kokubunji City will also change to the Tokyo Tama-Chubu Child Guidance Center.
changes: Remove Suginami City from the area served by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government's child guidance centers
Establish the Tokyo Suginami Child Guidance Center under the name Tokyo Tama-Chubu Child Guidance Center
Make the Tokyo Tama-Chubu Child Guidance Center responsible for Musashino City and Mitaka City
Transfer responsibility for Koganei City and Kokubunji City from the Tokyo Kodaira Child Guidance Center to the Tokyo Tama-Chubu Child Guidance Center
who: People who use child guidance center services in Suginami City
People who use child guidance center services in Musashino City and Mitaka City
People who use child guidance center services in Koganei City
People who use child guidance center services in Kokubunji City
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government says the amendments are to reorganize provisions concerning Suginami City's administrative work following an amendment to the Order for Enforcement of the Child Welfare Act, and to make changes needed to establish the Tokyo Tama-Chubu Child Guidance Center.
